Subject: Follow-up: Recap + path to econ buyer & procurement contacts

Hi Amit — great to meet today, and thanks for the time. Quick recap from our 30-min call and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Call highlights
- ClearWave goal: reduce inference cost for clinical NLP pipelines while keeping p99 latency under 150ms for triage workloads.
- Current infra: mixed cloud GPUs + some on-prem for PHI; security gate (SOC2 + NHS-style DPA) is mandatory.
- Trial wish-list: 2-week pilot (small dataset) + perf/quality metrics; decision criteria: cost per 1k tokens, avg latency, and integration effort.

Open asks / next steps
1) Economic buyer: can you introduce the person who owns the budget/purchasing authority? We want to understand procurement cadence and any internal approval thresholds.
2) Security/legal: please share the best contact (or vendor questionnaire) that handles SOC2/DPA review.
3) Pilot kickoff: I attached a one-page MAP (mutual action plan) and an evaluation pack. Proposed kickoff window: week of Mar 15.

Attachments: RW-Prod-Eval-MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan), Redwood-MSA-stub.pdf (high level contract template for reference)

If it helps, I can loop in our Solutions Engineer (Vivek) for a short technical walkthrough with your infra/security folks. I’ll follow up mid-week if I don’t hear back.

Cheers,
Rachel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks Rachel — great summary. A couple quick items: 

1) Economic buyer: I don't hold the budget for enterprise-wide infra. The finance owner is Lisa Breno (cc'd). She owns procurement and approval for vendor spend above $50k/year. If you can send a short one-pager aimed at the finance audience (cost/ROI), that would help.
2) Security: procurement@clearwavehealth.com handles the vendor security intake. We use a standard questionnaire and require SOC2 Type II and a DPA for PHI. Expect a handful of legal redlines around data residency.
3) Pilot timeline: week of Mar 15 works for us — but I will need Lisa's sign-off on the trial scope (budget/time commitment).

Happy to jump on a 20-min mute demo if Vivek wants to show the integration.

Best,

Hi Lisa — nice to be connected. Per Amit: short ask below, and two suggestions to move the procurement/security conversation forward quickly.

Quick asks for Lisa (economic buyer / procurement):
- Can you confirm budget approval thresholds and whether a pilot under $10k needs formal PO?
- If helpful, I can summarize the pilot ROI in an executive one-pager (expected delta in throughput/cost) by EOD tomorrow.

Suggested low-friction steps
1) Security intake: Rachel to drop a single-slide SOC2 + data-flow summary and the test dataset handling plan into procurement@clearwavehealth.com. Vivek to be on standby for any technical follow-up.
2) Pilot contract: propose a 2-week non-production pilot under a short SOW with predefined success metrics — we can use the attached MSA-stub and follow ClearWave's procurement checklist.
3) Intro ask: if budget owner prefers, we can structure a small PO (<= $10k) that avoids a lengthy procurement cycle; if PO not possible, let me know the PO owner and timing.

Proposed next steps / tentative calendar
- Rachel to send the exec one-pager + SOC2 slide by 5pm PT today.
- If agreeable, 20-min tech walkthrough with Vivek on Fri, Mar 6 at 10:00am PT (link: https://cal.com/rachel-kim/15).

Would you like me to include a suggested MAP with milestones and approval checkpoints? I attached the MAP already but can tailor it to ClearWave's procurement gates.

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

Rachel
